Choice Privileges - Points.com: Official portal for buying Choice Privileges hotel points. Worth a look during bonus sales when you're a few points short of a specific stay; price the room in cash first.
Cocorrina Scents: Reed diffusers and home scents designed to last for weeks without a flame. A low-effort way to keep a room smelling good; check the oil base if you have pets that knock things over.
Coivas: A wellness and pharmacy-category brand selling health products online. Read the product claims carefully and run anything you take regularly past your doctor.
COLAMY: Ergonomic office chairs and seating with modern styling. Check seat height range and weight rating against your body before buying; an hour a day in the wrong chair adds up.
COLMI: Budget smartwatches and fitness bands with heart rate, SpO2 and sleep tracking at a fraction of big-brand prices. A good first smartwatch or a gym beater; don't treat the health readings as medical-grade.
COLORDIAMONDS LED MASK: An FDA-cleared at-home LED mask combining red and blue light for aging and acne. A real device rather than a gimmick, but results take consistent weeks of use; ships from the UK.
Copa Airlines ConnectMiles - Points.com: Official portal for buying Copa ConnectMiles. Useful for topping off a Latin America award ticket during a bonus sale; otherwise cash is usually cheaper.
Cosabella (US): Female-founded Italian-style lingerie, sleepwear and loungewear built for comfort as much as looks. Their soft lace bralettes are the cult item; check the size chart since fits run differently than mall brands.
Coupert Limited (US): A browser extension that tests coupon codes at checkout and offers cash back. Fine to run in the background; just know extensions can overwrite the affiliate credit of the creators you meant to support.
Cozeware: Air purifiers and climate-control devices with sleek designs at mid-range prices. Match the CADR rating to your room size and check the cost of replacement filters.
A Miami retailer of outdoor furniture, patio heaters and garden products that stocks most of what it sells. Stocked inventory means faster, more predictable shipping on big pieces.
Crazy Domains Affiliate Program: Domain registration, web hosting and email. Compare renewal prices, not just the first-year rate, before you move a domain.
Crown and Paw: Custom pet portraits drawn by real designers from your photo, printed on canvas, posters, mugs and more. A sure-fire gift for pet people; order early before holidays.
curtainuk: Ready-made and made-to-measure curtains and window treatments. Ships from the UK; measure twice and check delivery times to the US.
D8 Super Store: A hemp and alt-cannabinoid shop run by a team with 15+ years in distribution, carrying delta-8 and other hemp-derived products. Check your state's rules, read the lab report for each item, and start low; 21+.
Daily High Club Affiliate Program: Monthly smoking subscription boxes plus a big accessory shop, heavy on papers, grinders and glass. A different curation taste than Cannabox; compare both against the Pixie's Pantry boxes before subscribing.
A deal site with rotating discounts on gadgets, home goods and accessories. Prices can be good, but compare against the brand's own site before buying.
Daneey: Affordable home decor sized for small apartments and rentals. Good for quick refreshes; check dimensions since 'small space' pieces can be smaller than they look in photos.
DankStop: A long-running online glass and accessory headshop under High Tide. Deep selection of American-made borosilicate; good for comparing joint sizes and percolator styles side by side.
Databazaar.com: Printer ink, toner and office supplies, including compatible cartridges at lower prices. Check page yield and printer compatibility before switching from OEM ink.
DaVinci Vaporizers: Portable dry herb vaporizers like the IQ series and ARTIQ, built around precise temperature control and clean airpaths. One of the Pixie's Pantry heart brands, and the pick when you want control and pure materials in a pocket device.
DaySavers: Rolling papers and cones tested to regulated-cannabis standards for heavy metals, microbials and pesticides. You inhale the paper too, so this matters; their Perfect Pack machine makes cones fast and consistent.
DermAvenue: Discounted skincare from established brands, with a medical-leaning selection. Good for restocking products you already know work; check expiration dates on clearance items.
DHgate: A wholesale marketplace selling directly from factories, including glass, grinders and shop supplies. Fine for bulk basics where brand doesn't matter; skip anything you inhale through, since there are no lab or material guarantees.
Diamond Veneer Travel Jewelry: High-end cubic zirconia jewelry made to look like fine diamonds, sold as 'travel jewelry' so the real pieces stay home. Smart for trips and events where you don't want to risk losing the real thing.
Dima Eyewear (US): Eco-minded sunglasses with durable frames at direct-to-consumer prices. Check for polarized and UV400 labels before you buy.
Distacart: Ships Indian groceries, Ayurvedic and homeopathic products and beauty items overseas from a 60,000-item catalog. The go-to when you can't find a specific Indian brand locally; check customs rules on food items.
Dr. Tobias: Vitamins, probiotics, omega-3s and digestive supplements. Look for third-party testing on the specific product and check with your doctor if you take medications.
Dr.Dabber: Electronic dab rigs and pens like the Boost EVO and Switch 2. Pixie's Pantry is an authorized vendor, so warranties are real; the least fussy way to dab at an accurate temperature.
DRYWORLD: Performance athletic apparel and gear designed with pro athletes. Check sizing charts; performance fits often run tighter.
DynaVap: Battery-free, torch-heated dry herb vaporizers machined from stainless steel and titanium, with a cap that clicks at the right heat. Nothing to charge or fail, and parts are rebuildable; made in Wisconsin. My code DUSTY works here.
EarthKind: Plant-based pest repellents, EPA-registered or FIFRA-exempt, built to be safe around kids and pets when used as directed. Good for rodents in sheds, cars and barns; it repels rather than kills.
EasyClaw: An AI productivity platform for automating everyday work tasks. Try it on one repetitive job first; AI tools are only worth paying for when they save time weekly.
Easyship Ambassador Program: A shipping platform for small businesses: compare carrier rates, print labels, handle returns and calculate duties for international orders. Real time-saver if you ship more than a few packages a week.
Eayon hair: Human braiding hair, crochet locs and twists, clip-ins and HD lace wigs. Strong pick for protective styles; check hair type and length for the look you want.
ECOVACS Robotics Best Buy Seller: ECOVACS robot vacuums and mops sold through Best Buy. Compare the Best Buy price and return window against ECOVACS direct; pet hair households should look at self-emptying models.
ECOVACS Robotics Walmart Seller: ECOVACS robot vacuums and mops sold through Walmart. Same products as ECOVACS direct; whichever retailer has the better price and return policy wins.
Edens Herbals CBD: US-made CBD products from a veteran-owned company. Check the batch lab report and start with a low dose if you're new to CBD.
Edify: Hemp- and mushroom-derived edibles and drinks pitched as everyday social alternatives. Check your state's hemp rules, read the lab report, and start low; 21+.
EFE: Trendy eyeglass frames in TR90, acetate and metal from about $20 to $200. Budget-friendly way to own more than one pair; double-check your PD and prescription entry.
EKOUAER: Women's pajamas, robes and loungewear at low prices. Comfortable basics; check fabric content if you sleep hot.
EngageBay CRM: An all-in-one CRM, email marketing and helpdesk platform priced for small businesses. A cheaper alternative to HubSpot for a small team; test the free plan first.
Enjox Toys: App-connected intimate products for couples, including long-distance use, with body-safe materials and encrypted connections. Read the privacy details for any app-linked device; 18+.
Enjoy Hemp: Hemp-derived THC and CBD products with an emphasis on consistency. Check your state's rules and the lab report for each batch; 21+.
Eonon (US): Aftermarket car stereos and head units with CarPlay and Android Auto options. Match the unit to your car's dash size and wiring; their monthly clearance sales can be deep.
Erverte Paris: French luxury menswear made in France from natural fibers, built around ethical sourcing. Expensive and built to last; ships from France.
eSign: Sign PDF DOCX Documents (iOS only: An iPhone app for signing PDF and Word documents on the go. Handy for quick contracts; check subscription pricing before the trial ends.
eSIM4Travel - Best eSIM Packages for fam: Travel eSIMs for 180+ destinations with packages aimed at families. Compare price per gigabyte for your route against Airalo and Bcengi.
esimcards: UK-focused eSIMs on major networks like Vodafone, O2, EE and Three, plus travel eSIMs for visitors to the UK. Most useful if your trip is mainly Britain.
Esimi US: Global travel eSIMs for 200+ countries, activated by QR code. Another option to price-compare for multi-country trips.
ESIMUSA.com: eSIM plans for travellers visiting the United States. Send this one to international friends and family flying in.
eSIMX: A marketplace for comparing and buying mobile and eSIM offers. Useful for side-by-side price checks before a trip.
ETechBuy.com: A California-based seller of servers, storage, networking and IT hardware with bulk pricing. Built for small businesses and home labs; confirm condition (new vs refurbished) on each listing.
Eufy NL & CA: Eufy security cameras, robot vacuums and baby monitors for shoppers in the Netherlands and Canada. US shoppers should use Eufy US instead.
Eufy US: Anker's smart home line: security cameras with local storage, robot vacuums and baby monitors. Local storage means no monthly fee for many cameras, which is the main reason to pick Eufy.
eufyMake: The eufyMake E1, a personal UV printer that prints raised, textured designs onto objects. A real small-business tool for custom merch, tumblers and phone cases; budget for ink.
EVDANCE: Home EV chargers and charging accessories. Check your car's connector type and whether you need an electrician for a 240V outlet; ships from Europe.
Everblog US: Camera smart glasses and wearable tech for hands-free recording. Know the recording-consent laws where you'll use them.
EverLeakProof US: Reusable leakproof underwear for periods and bladder leaks. Saves money over disposables; check absorbency level and wash care.
EYCE LLC: Platinum-cured silicone pipes, rigs and molds that are effectively unbreakable. The right call for travel, outdoors and homes with hard floors; a Pixie's Pantry heart brand.
Eydology: Affordable prescription glasses and sunglasses sold direct. Have a current prescription and your PD handy before ordering.
FabFinds: UK discount retailer of cleaning products, beauty, home and pantry items. UK shoppers only.
FansJerseyHub: Football-inspired jerseys and fan apparel aimed at World Cup 2026. These are 'inspired' designs, not official licensed kits; know what you're buying.
Fantastic Tees (US): Patriotic and faith-themed graphic tees and hoodies. Check the size chart and fabric blend.
FED Fitness US: Space-saving home gym equipment from brands like BCAN rebounders, Yosuda bikes and Flybird benches. Good value; check weight limits and folded dimensions.
FENRIR: Motorcycle parts and accessories. Confirm fitment for your exact make, model and year before ordering.
Findlys: A business directory and vendor listing platform. Only useful if you're a business looking for listings; check what the paid tier actually adds.
Fire Maple gear: Compact camping stoves, cookware and fuel canisters. Good, light gear at fair prices; check fuel canister compatibility.
Portable propane plow-disc cookers for tailgates, camps and big outdoor cookouts. A crowd-pleaser for feeding a lot of people at once; made in Texas.
Flextail: Tiny rechargeable air pumps, lanterns and ultralight camping appliances. The pocket pump is a genuinely useful tool for pads, floats and mattresses.
FliKEZE: Red light therapy panels, LED masks, massage guns and neck devices. Results take consistent use; compare power output if you're choosing between panels.
FliKEZE (2): A second FliKEZE storefront for the same light-therapy and recovery products. Compare prices against the main FliKEZE listing.
FORTHiQ: Wellness supplements and health products. Look for third-party testing and talk to your doctor if you take medications.
FRIZZLIFE INC: Reverse-osmosis water systems, under-sink filters and leak detectors. RO is the real upgrade for bad tap water; check filter replacement costs.
FUMECLEAR: Fume extractors for laser engraving, soldering, salons and labs. Pair one with a laser engraver; the fumes from burning wood and acrylic are not something to breathe.
Nerdy trivia card games and educational prints. Good stocking stuffers and game-night picks.
Future Formulations: Dr. Wilson's supplements for adrenal, stress, blood sugar, immune and digestive support. Talk to your doctor before starting anything for blood sugar.
GamingKit: UK retailer of gaming peripherals, PC accessories and console gear. UK shoppers only; compare shipping if you're ordering from the US.
Gardenreet LLC: Garden and outdoor structures like sheds, greenhouses and pergolas with large average orders. Check assembly requirements and local permit rules for bigger builds.
Garvee Innovation Inc: A wide catalog of furniture, tools, garden equipment and home goods. Good for value finds; read reviews on individual items since quality varies.
GearUP: Software that reduces ping, packet loss and lag in online games. Most helpful on long-distance servers and spotty rural internet; try the free trial first.
GeekShare: Cute Nintendo Switch thumb grips, cases and carrying bags. Easy, affordable gifts for gamers.
Geekvape: A major vape hardware brand selling pod systems and mods. Check your state's shipping rules for vape devices; 21+.
GetOut: A family membership for discounted access to local attractions. Worth it if your area has participating venues you'll visit more than once; check the list first.
Gigsberg US: A resale ticket marketplace for concerts, sports and theatre worldwide. Compare total price after fees against official sellers, and check the buyer guarantee.
Gisou: Honey-infused hair oils and haircare by Negin Mirsalehi. Premium-priced; the hair oil is the signature product.
Gizmo AI: An AI study app that turns notes and lecture slides into flashcards and quizzes using spaced repetition. Genuinely useful for students; the free tier is a good test.
GL Capital Ventures LLC: Goldleaf's illustrated cannabis cooking and growing journals, prints and kitchen tools. A great gift for a home cook or grower; featured in High Times and Bon Appetit.
GL Technologies (Hong Kong) Limited: GL.iNet travel and home routers, including VPN-ready pocket routers. Handy for hotels and rentals; a little technical to set up.
GLISSANT: Intimate wellness products and lubricants. Check ingredients and compatibility with any toys or condoms; 18+.
